title: Direct report counts
statementMd:
For each manager, show their first name and how many direct reports they have.

Expected columns: `first_name`, `reports`.

Tables: `employees`, `departments`.

Row order does not matter.
hints: Group the employees by `manager_id`, then join back for the name.
solutionMd:
```sql
SELECT m.first_name, COUNT(*) AS reports FROM employees e JOIN employees m ON m.id = e.manager_id GROUP BY m.id, m.first_name;
```

Compare with your own query; the result sets must match.
